summary: Coincheck Group N.V. filed a Form 6-K to disclose preliminary monthly operating metrics for Coincheck, Inc., its Japanese crypto-asset subsidiary. The filing provides exchange and marketplace trading volumes, customer assets, and verified account counts for the past twelve months (June 2025–May 2026). No transaction, extraordinary corporate event, or special situation is announced; the filing is a routine business update under SEC Rule 13a-16. The data is preliminary, unaudited, and subject to immaterial adjustments. This Form 6-K serves as a voluntary disclosure of operational KPIs and does not trigger any event-driven special situation classification.
